description: Deterministically compare the actual graph against the manifest target and emit a typed Conflict envelope (id, type, severity, locations, description, suggested_fixes, evidence) via a pluggable detector registry that accepts new conflict types without changing the envelope.

requirements.description: Cartographer must deterministically compare the actual code graph against the manifest target and emit typed Conflict envelopes (AC-CONFLICT-ENVELOPE) containing: id, type, severity, locations, description, suggested_fixes, evidence, resolved, and resolution fields. A pluggable Detector interface and registry (AC-DETECTOR-REGISTRY) must allow new conflict types to be registered without modifying the envelope schema. Day-one detectors must include cycle detection (AC-DETECTOR-CYCLE) and mislocated_file detection (AC-DETECTOR-MISLOCATED). Severity classification and aggregation logic (AC-CONFLICT-SEVERITY) must map detector findings to severities defined in the manifest or built-in thresholds. The envelope schema must be considered stable across versions.
requirements.title: Drift Findings Engine with Pluggable Detector Registry

validation.notes: AC-CONFLICT-ENVELOPE: Serialization round-trip (struct → JSON/proto → struct) preserves all fields including resolved and resolution
AC-CONFLICT-ENVELOPE: Adding a new detector does not require changes to the envelope struct or serialization code
AC-DETECTOR-REGISTRY: Registering a new detector via the registry interface makes it invocable without modifying core engine code
AC-DETECTOR-REGISTRY: Detectors are invoked in deterministic order (sorted by type ID) to ensure reproducible output
AC-DETECTOR-CYCLE: A fixture graph with a known 3-node import cycle produces a conflict envelope with type=cycle and correct locations
AC-DETECTOR-MISLOCATED: A fixture graph with a file in domain A importing exclusively from domain B produces a mislocated_file conflict
AC-CONFLICT-SEVERITY: Severity is classified as error/warning/info based on manifest thresholds; default thresholds apply when manifest omits them
End-to-end: extract graph from bas/fixtures/go-cycles/ → run drift engine → output matches hand-curated expected-conflicts.json
End-to-end: extract graph from bas/fixtures/ts-junk-drawer/ → run drift engine → mislocated_file conflicts detected and envelopes are valid
Plugging in a test-only detector via registry produces its conflicts in the output alongside built-in detector conflicts
An agent reviewing conflicts receives a fully self-contained Conflict envelope with enough information to understand and act on the finding without reading source code
Conflict IDs are stable across re-runs when the underlying violation has not changed, enabling deduplication in downstream systems

title: Drift Findings Engine
